purpose: The original R10 objective is unchanged: material-compatible touchdown, followed by a stable frozen-PANN/standard-PPO/same-MPC baseline. This pre-execution revision changes scheduling, training scale and continuous-task coverage; it contains no new experimental results.

history.R9_status: 8 material development starts, 0 complete missions; PANN observer and PPO training/evaluation not executed
history.revision_scope: User confirmed R10 had not started. Do not restart counters if execution records are nevertheless discovered; preserve and reconcile actual starts.

configuration_reuse.rule: Read both at reviewed_source_commit. Reuse physics, PANN feature definitions, original single-mission criteria and PPO settings unless explicitly overridden here. Current R10 controls run identity, sample targets, curriculum, termination semantics, parallelism and evaluation. Do not launch the closed R9 campaign or inherit its hard-coded workers/host/49152-step budget. Emit one actual resolved configuration.

plant_invariants.robot: project four-legged Go2, 15.206408 kg; original geometry/inertia/passive parameters/limits; G0/G1 are historical cohort labels, not humanoid hardware
plant_invariants.material: unchanged ReferenceColumns tm02_anchor and original constitutive parameters
plant_invariants.boundary_rule: unchanged hard-priority footprint assignment, unique support; retain non-foot collisions
plant_invariants.history_rule: World-fixed shared columns recover when unloaded. Reset only between independent episodes/acquisition sessions, never at PPO updates, laps or file boundaries.
plant_invariants.prohibited: softening truth to pass, clipping material strain/force, injecting planned GRF, relaxing task/physical limits, replacing the training plant or controller

controller_development.new_controller_name: S4 after actual implementation; preserve frozen R8-S3 identity and results
controller_development.starting_data: Use execution-host R9 contact/failure windows, actual build source and corresponding plans; no new short diagnostic episodes or redundant asset downloads.
controller_development.G: Confirm and correct model-derived center/sole geometry: upstream .020 m reference versus project .022 m physical foot. Preserve physical geometry. Source mismatch alone is not a verified sole cause.
controller_development.N: Put smooth approach and predicted actual normal-velocity/indentation objectives inside the same MPC. Initially retain 2 Hz gait, .45 duty and .03 m apex; preserve phase continuity. A zero-speed reference is not a guarantee on actual touchdown. No post-solve torque or target filter.
controller_development.conditional_C: If full-mission evidence still indicates contact prediction mismatch, implement one documented local short-horizon contact approximation in the same solver. Candidate forces come from candidate states, finite-difference/rollout states are independent and derivatives match the implemented transition. Do not copy current applied forces to all candidates or assume userdata automatically propagates material state.
controller_development.prediction_clock: Retain .350 s horizon and 2 ms held actions with matching composed derivatives. Finer predictor substeps, if needed, do not change plant truth or silently shorten the horizon.
controller_development.cap_rule: Start at .25; alternative caps only characterize the modified controller, not a repeated R9 sweep. Freeze the first successful predeclared controller/cap before comparison.
controller_development.stand_reference: Keep S3 feasible references and Stand Effort scale .02 rad/weight .08 on rigid endpoint pads; force tracking remains disabled.
controller_development.training_entry: One same-version complete original nominal material mission permits freezing S4 and starting joint learning. Neither all initial conditions nor prior 600 s perfection is required.
controller_development.stop: Preserve the actual blocker if all bounded development fails. Do not refresh the allowance, modify truth or switch platform. Observer/interface work already feasible may still be delivered, without claiming closed-loop learning.

joint_learning.fixed_group_cap: first successful predeclared development cap, frozen before evaluation
joint_learning.actor_action: single speed cap [.18,.25] m/s; .215+.035*sample.action, where existing sample.action is already tanh(raw); retain raw action/log_prob
joint_learning.shared_controller: All three groups use identical frozen S4, truth, limits and task interfaces; common touchdown improvements are not PANN gains.
joint_learning.shared_observation: R9 raw proprioception, public task/strip information and preceding 1 s at 20 Hz. Add shared task-type flag and normalized intrinsic remaining time for finite 60 s training; use a mask and no artificial sampling-deadline countdown for continuing stages. Both PPO groups receive identical non-PANN channels.
joint_learning.pann: Frozen B_random1000--ideal seed0 and original normalization; independent causal LearnedColumns world state, no true material q/e input
joint_learning.pann_features: Preserve R9 2 ms causal observer, latest completed plan t+.20 s four footprints, private zero-load recovery at2/200/500 ms and12 area-weighted signed depressions. Shared public query positions/masks; RAW prediction channels zero. Match world keys, not array row indices; queries do not alter truth or observer.
joint_learning.observer_preparation: Can proceed alongside controller development using existing causal trajectories. Replay/network loading is not closed-loop success or PPO training.

ppo.implementation: existing standard Tianshou PPO core; no algorithm/platform replacement
ppo.device: Resolve on authorized hardware once before training; use the same actor/critic device policy for both groups. A small PPO network need not be enlarged to occupy VRAM.

joint_learning.primary_checkpoint_rule: Use exactly32768 for all six streams when achieved, otherwise the last common completed multiple of256 before the reserved evaluation deadline. Report shortfall. No formal-performance-based checkpoint or seed selection.
joint_learning.optional_training_rule: Only after all six standard checkpoints exist and core evaluation is completed or fully time-reserved, resume all six equally toward65536 within remaining authorized time. Optional weights do not replace the primary checkpoint. No unbudgeted second full evaluation matrix.
joint_learning.sampling_accounting: Record total/effective translating transitions, elapsed physics, actual resets, failures, PPO updates and component/campaign wall times. Stand/turn observations may be collected but separately count ineffective actions; no passive post-completion padding.
joint_learning.on_policy_and_independence: Separate parameters, optimizer, normalizers, seeds and environment/MPC/material/observer state for each stream. Collect each256-transition fragment under its fixed behavior policy; update only that stream and then continue its state. Do not mix other seeds or stale-policy fragments to fake on-policy data. Archive frozen evaluation normalizers with checkpoints.

curriculum.end_semantics: original success/failure/intrinsic timeout are terminal; successful training ends immediately, not after passive holding
real physical/material failure terminates;300s is an external acquisition truncation, not task failure
real physical/material failure terminates;600s is external acquisition truncation
same continuing-task semantics, no new action or reward design

joint_learning.curriculum_boundary_rule: Threshold crossings queue the next stage for the next natural episode/session boundary; never reset a running robot or material solely to hit8192/16384 exactly. Record actual per-stage counts and overshoot. Both methods use the same rule and initial-condition cycling nominal/yaw+5/yaw-5.
joint_learning.continuing_route: Endless0-to3-to0m circuits during each300/600s training session; stop2s under original thresholds at each endpoint and really turn before the next leg/lap. Completion of a lap is not session termination. No per-lap material or MPC reset, and no training parking after a fixed target lap count.
joint_learning.bootstrap_rule: True terminal: bootstrap0. Rollout cut: bootstrap actual successor and keep environment alive. External300/600s truncation: bootstrap saved final pre-reset observation, stop GAE recursion across the subsequent reset. Use distinct bootstrap and trace-continuation masks; never bootstrap reset observation or propagate advantages into the next episode. Technical interruption is not physical failure.

reward_adaptation.base: Frozen R9 physical progress/time/indentation/slip/applied-action-change reward and weights; no reward for predicted material or assumed beneficial compaction
reward_adaptation.rate_rule: Retain original dt/60 denominators and physical normalization in every training stage. Do not divide costs by300/600 or reweight to favor long sessions. Integrate actual dt, not nominal dt after early termination.
reward_adaptation.progress: Unwrapped signed actual translational progress divided by6m per circuit; split phase changes, include backward motion, no position-reset or phase-switch progress bonus.
reward_adaptation.events: Original single-task completion gives+10 once and terminates. In continuing stages give+10 once per fully completed circuit after original home stability, then continue. No completion reward for merely standing or at the far endpoint. Physical/material failure gives-10 once. Intrinsic60s timeout gives-5 without duplicate failure penalty; external300/600s truncation or technical deadline gives no timeout/failure penalty.
reward_adaptation.freeze: Same adapted reward and task semantics in both learning groups before training. No reward or hyperparameter sweep and no formal-result tuning.
reward_adaptation.interpretation: Long continuous execution is not proof of long-delay credit assignment; gamma remains.99 and the material memory time is determined by actual physics.

evaluation.freeze: Primary common checkpoints and normalizers fixed for entire evaluation trajectories; deterministic policy mean; no PPO updates during formal tests. PANN estimated states and MPC still evolve causally.

original_material.composition: 3 fixed +2 learned groups x3 training seeds x3 initial conditions
original_material.criteria: Unchanged original single mission; observe through60s, no newly added far-end hold

continuous_material.composition: 3 fixed +2 learned groups x3 training seeds x3 initial conditions; do not reduce learned coverage to seed0
continuous_material.start_rule: After each frozen group/seed policy passes its nominal60s full observation, schedule its three predeclared600s conditions. Do not wait for all other policies or for perturbed60s cases to be perfect. Failed/ineligible nominal policies stay listed with the reason; do not silently remove them or label unrun600s cases as tested failures/successes.
continuous_material.observation_rule: After10 circuits continue holding and record to600s; separately report moving/holding time, route completion and subsequent violations. Treat300s as an in-trajectory observation, not an independent extra trial.

extended_continuous_material.start_rule: Only predeclared FIXED and each learned seed0 whose same-version nominal600s passes, after core time reservation; no best-seed substitution.
Same predeclared policy whose nominal1800s passes, with core evaluation protected and enough authorized time; otherwise explicitly not executed.

evaluation.all_long_tasks: Original stability tolerances,2s holds at both endpoints and actual turns; no lap resets or stitched runs. At route completion hold until declared horizon and require final continuous2s stability; report every violation, final30s and each lap/60s segment. Failures terminate truthfully and remain in denominators. All durations are simulation time, not wall time.
evaluation.reuse: Exactly same source/config/checkpoint/initial state/protocol may be reused once. A shorter run or prefix is not an independent longer task; new durations are separately declared.
evaluation.interpretation: Three seeds and deterministic initial offsets are limited coverage, not held-out material generalization or robot certification. Joint execution, PANN changing actions and task gains are separate outcomes.

resources.host_selection: Use the user's already authorized96GB execution machine via existing SSH access. Confirm actual host, GPU, affinity/quota, RAM and active jobs once; fy-5080 is a legacy label, not authority to silently use a different machine. No new paid machine, purchase or hardware activation.
resources.concurrency_policy: Replace legacy fixed3 ceiling with allocated-resource/throughput limit. Increase evaluation concurrency beyond8 only while actual aggregate useful throughput improves and CPU/RAM/GPU allow; reduce on contention. Do not add training seeds or vector environments to a stream silently. Ready independent jobs run concurrently; causal development dependencies remain ordered.
resources.thread_memory_policy: Coordinate solver, BLAS/OpenMP, PyTorch and JAX threads; avoid every process consuming all CPUs. Configure JAX allocation or memory fractions per process and reserve space for other backends; large VRAM reservation is not compute utilization. Record host RAM separately from VRAM. No global modification to other users' environments.
resources.isolation: Independent ports, MPC server, RNG, states, optimizer and output directory. Running jobs read immutable source/binaries; parallel editors use isolated worktrees and never overwrite a running shared build. Rendering/publication use spare resources.
resources.throughput_measurement: Use already-required full episodes/rollout fragments, recording aggregate simulated seconds and valid transitions per wall hour plus component times. No separate benchmark or artificial short episodes. Comparing concurrency must account for task phase and method cost. Do not interrupt episodes only to adjust concurrency.
resources.platform: Retain native MuJoCo/iLQG and existing environments; do not migrate to MJX/Warp or a world model to fill GPU utilization. Slow synchronous simulation is not NX realtime.

budget.upper_bound_decomposition: 12 development +1 rigid regression +21 original60 +21 core600 +3 optional1800 +3 optional3600; exact reuse reduces starts
budget.wall_budget_authorization: Retain the existing48h ceiling: user approved scale but supplied no replacement numerical wall-time limit. Targets are not promises within48h. Any later extension needs an explicit recorded user limit; do not auto-extend, restart the clock or acquire resources.
budget.starts_at: first R10 physical integration; count all concurrent jobs against one elapsed clock including pauses, development, training and evaluation. Implementation/build/publication timing separately recorded.
budget.reserve_rule: Reserve max(6h,1.2x measured parallel wall cost of all remaining eligible core21x60+21x600 plus required regression). Account for the actual worker allocation/contention, not summed single-job time divided by an assumed perfect speedup. Recompute from normal complete jobs/fragments; stop training in time to preserve core evaluation.
priority: balanced six-stream core training and21x60+21x600 evaluation
optional65536 training and1800/3600 only with core fully protected
budget.shortfall: Evaluate last common actual checkpoint and disclose missing training/evaluation. Do not claim32768, convergence, all21 tasks or one-hour execution when not achieved. Preserve unfinished task as budget-truncated, not fabricated physical failure.

outputs.required: actual source/config/checkpoint/normalizer/binary identities; all starts and full outcomes; actual training curves and sample counts;60/600/optional1800/3600 separated; full positive/negative evaluation videos; causal touchdown/recovery/revisit records; real component and campaign timing
outputs.segmented_metrics: Per lap and per60s completion/progress, slip, contact peaks, posture, material/observer error where comparable, MPC timing, RAM/VRAM and state-map size. Separate movement and passive holding; energy comparisons on comparable completed tasks, not early-failure savings.
outputs.training_logging: compact transitions/episodes, checkpoints and selected full videos, not every MPC horizon at every training step; high-rate event windows and necessary physics remain inspectable
outputs.publication: Source/config/compact results toGitHub; arrays/checkpoints/videos directly from execution host toRelease, each asset<2GiB with continuous timestamps. Verify final commit and URL/size/digest, then finish.
prohibited_post_publication: download another copy to user's PC
copy or mirror to user's PC
recompress or create a second local archive
automatic deletion of working data or history
outputs.retention: Keep normal execution outputs, necessary checkpoints and historical evidence. No archival-only work after publication verification.
